اعتكدتم (form VIII)
# اِعْتَكَدْتُمْ (iʕtakadtum) /iʕ.ta.kad.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
# اُعْتُكِدْتُمْ (uʕtukidtum) /uʕ.tu.kid.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
